shared_schema.input: status=ok, stage=input, results={}; data holds a labeled synthetic fixture, ISO as_of date, customer/KYC profile, ledger, linked loan application, issues, documents, knowledge_base and question.
shared_schema.output: Same envelope, stage=faq, canonical masked data, and all four validated cumulative results.
shared_schema.errors: A JSON object with schema_version, status=error and an error code/message; exit 2. No raw input values or file paths in errors.

ledger_formats.json: Array of transactions with id, amount, currency, account, counterparty_iban, card_number and screening_flags.
ledger_formats.csv: Exact same ordered columns; screening_flags is a pipe-separated cell. Empty ledgers may contain only the header.
ledger_formats.iso20022: Demonstrative JSON subset: MsgId and PmtInf array; each payment has DbtrAcct.Id and CdtTrfTxInf array. Each transfer has PmtId.EndToEndId, Amt.InstdAmt.{Value,Ccy}, CdtrAcct.IBAN, CardNumber and ScreeningFlags. Not an ISO 20022 schema validator.

shared_schema.validation: Strict field sets, bounded collections/text, linked loan ownership, unique entity IDs, enum/boolean checks, date checks, decimal amounts and synthetic account/IBAN rules. Every transition validates predecessor stage order, canonical masked data and recomputes prior deterministic results to reject inconsistent handoffs.
shared_schema.document_evidence: Final, nonexpired, non-future evidence must match the customer/loan and contain type-specific fields. Identity names and loan amount/currency/purpose must match. All candidate document IDs and rejection reasons are retained.
shared_schema.amounts: Finite positive amounts up to 1,000,000,000 with at most two fractional digits; normalized decimal strings; USD/EUR/GBP only.

behavior.determinism: Fixed lexicon, explicit weights, stable ID tie-breaks and explicit as_of date; no runtime randomness. The test suite creates seeded randomized synthetic transaction histories.
behavior.sentiment: Token-weight sum clipped to [-5,5]; full token contributions. Fraud/unauthorized terms elevate severity to critical. Priority is severity base plus a bounded negative-sentiment boost; every score carries its formula and components.
behavior.adaptive: Experience and pace select optional orientation; presentation follows preferences. Mandatory profile/identity/screening/ledger/loan prerequisites remain unchanged. Each module explains its status and blockers.
behavior.review: Evidence completeness does not approve loans, certify compliance or clear screening holds; even a manual-review document cannot automatically clear input flags.
behavior.faq: Ranks applicable supplied entries using question overlap and review-context bonus, with every component explained. Context alone cannot retrieve an unrelated answer. Returns up to two exact excerpts with source IDs; explicitly abstains without applicable question overlap.
behavior.industry_constraints: Demonstrative supplied KYC/AML flag propagation, human-review holds, synthetic-only account/ZZ IBAN validation, and PCI DSS-inspired masking of 13–19 digit card-like strings, including free text. Masking alone is not PCI DSS compliance.
behavior.privacy: Only last four card digits survive normalization; output contains synthetic customer/evidence data and is not a general PII anonymizer.

excluded: Live LLMs or injected model steps
Semantic entailment or document authenticity verification

test_outcomes.cli_output: One JSON object with status=ok and stage=faq; masked cards and all four cumulative results.
test_outcomes.error_behavior: Missing-file subprocess and mocked malformed JSON, schema, duplicate-key, nonfinite-number, excessive-size, oversized-integer and usage cases return JSON status=error and exit 2.
